goal: Given immutable normalized source projections for an existing or previously published book, reconstruct an evidence-linked proposed Book semantic state, preserve uncertainty and competing version interpretations, obtain author decisions only through the existing author-decision boundary, and emit an immutable RecoveredBookBaseline plus prerequisite-derived exact next work without silent invention.
inputs: source admission refs carrying immutable source identity/digest and provenance
normalized document projections from delegated file/OCR/PDF/DOCX providers
extracted structural anchors and mechanically provable metadata
existing Book project state when re-entering an already-known project
outputs: ReconstructedBookStructure with confidence/evidence and unresolved-boundary findings
ProposedBookSemanticState containing evidence-linked intent/audience/metadata/voice/knowledge candidates without automatic canonization
RecoveryFinding ledger for conflicts, loss, ambiguity, missing information and unresolved authority
AuthorDecisionBatch for only the unresolved choices requiring author authority
RecoveredBookBaseline with exact input refs/digests, selected revision graph, reconstructed structure, ratified/proposed state, unresolved findings, maturity vector and exact-next work
required_semantics: detect exact duplicates and preserve near-duplicate candidates without collapsing semantic identity
never select authoritative latest manuscript from filesystem timestamp alone
recover front matter, parts, chapters, sections/scenes and ordering from evidence-linked structure
preserve ambiguous structural boundaries as findings instead of guessing
construct candidate version/revision graph from content and internal revision evidence
extract mechanically provable metadata separately from semantic proposals
recover citation/source references in imported form without silently upgrading truth standing
build proposed VoiceProfile only from sufficiently attributable passages
detect explicit TODO/TBD/comments/editor queries/missing citations/open questions
batch author questions and proposed defaults with supporting evidence rather than asking the author to re-enter known facts
record author ratification/rejection/correction through the existing author-decision service and exact-current-subject guard
derive BookMaturityProfile from satisfied prerequisites and unresolved blockers
select exact next work from the first incomplete dependency-valid gate rather than a naive linear stage
create RecoveredBookBaseline immutably and join the native Book lifecycle only when loss, invention and authority blockers are truthfully represented
support NEW_EDITION/re-entry lineage without rewriting historical accepted editions
authority_invariants: Book owns semantic reconstruction/re-entry meaning; PLATFORM-008 owns raw/original artifact bytes.
DATA/021L own physical persistence, backup/PITR and disaster-recovery mechanics.
OCR/PDF/DOCX providers own native extraction mechanics; normalized provider output is untrusted input until Book semantic admission.
Story Bible owns canon/world-state truth; recovery may propose candidates but cannot silently ratify them.
Research/Evidence owns external evidence truth; imported research does not auto-become Book canon or accepted manuscript text.
Writing/Manuscript retain accepted-text/manuscript identity authority; recovery does not create a second textual truth owner.
Author remains final authority for ambiguous creative/semantic choices.
SYSTEM-ORCHESTRATOR/Book jobs remain durable execution authority; this slice does not create another orchestrator.
No hosted result is relabeled as A-01, native, human, empirical, publication or production PASS.

idempotency_and_recovery.idempotency_key: book_project_or_recovery_session + ordered exact source identities/digests + recovery_profile_version
idempotency_and_recovery.rerun_rule: Same exact inputs/profile produce the same evidence-normalized recovery proposal and stable semantic identities, excluding explicitly nondeterministic provider fields which must be normalized or rejected from authority decisions.
idempotency_and_recovery.checkpoint_rule: Checkpoint after source census, candidate revision graph, structure reconstruction, semantic candidate extraction, author-decision preparation and baseline assembly. Resume from the latest valid checkpoint after exact input/profile revalidation.
idempotency_and_recovery.mutation_rule: No canonical Book mutation occurs until required author/canonical admission gates pass; intermediate recovery state is proposal/evidence state.

minimum_qualification_cases: previously published edition plus later partial revision
filesystem timestamps that disagree with internal revision evidence
fiction case producing Story Bible candidates without auto-canonization
nonfiction case producing claims/evidence/term candidates without auto-acceptance
stale author-decision subject after manuscript successor creation
repeated identical recovery request proving idempotent output
NEW_EDITION re-entry preserving prior edition lineage

implementation_first_increment.scope: Pure semantic recovery engine over synthetic normalized JSON fixtures; no native parser/provider calls.
deliverables: deterministic qualifier covering minimum qualification cases
qualification summary with exact software subject SHA when hosted
implementation_first_increment.exit: All semantic invariants and minimum synthetic cases pass with zero canonical mutation outside existing admission/author-decision boundaries.
